scope: Actual App and Vue controls, native-event protocol and user input; IPC/disk simulated here, real filesystem tested separately
checks: Moving a referenced file detects unsaved changes in the incoming note; both the disk location and draft stay intact, and the interface remains usable
The move refreshes the incoming editor and cached tab, preserves the user-saved content and unrelated unsaved draft, and recovers a lost release event
Interrupted moves remain accessible after reopening the app through a context menu; the review dialog shows actual positions, preserves failure and allows explicit retry
